selectionEntries.name: Pacific Islands Close Air Support Table

rules.name: Machine Gun Bunker
rules.description: 3 men and a tripod Type 92 HMG in reinforced cover. The cover is lost if the HMG team moves.

rules.name: Tatakai!
rules.description: This Battlegroup is determined to fight to the very end, no retreat, no surrender. At the start of the game, roll a D6 and add the result to the Battlegroup's total BR. Also, the Battlegroup gains +1 to its Command and Control rolls.

selectionEntryGroups.name: Roll 1D6 for +BR Rating; select result here

rules.name: Cautious Enemy
rules.description: The enemy forces you are facing expect that the war will soon be over and aren't willing to risk high casualties and unnecessary losses. At the start of the game reduce the enemy player's BR total by a D6.
